download_dynamicreplica_dataset: download the Dynamic Replica dataset to a target directory using parallel workers
extract_dynamicreplica_archives: extract the downloaded Dynamic Replica zip archives to a specified directory
run_download_extract_pipeline: run the download and extract pipeline for the Dynamic Replica dataset with configurable stages
download_dynamicreplica_with_workers: download the Dynamic Replica dataset using a specified number of parallel workers
download_dynamicreplica_stages: run specific stages like download or extract for the Dynamic Replica dataset
